title: "Property Crime"

Property crime concerns theft, burglary, damage, and taking. The central question is how opportunity and expected payoff interact with enforcement and guardianship.

## Mechanisms to connect

- target attractiveness
- guardianship and surveillance
- routine activity
- displacement after intervention

## Models to try

- search and target-selection models
- inspection games
- spatial hot-spot models
